title: Average the bonus across everyone
prompt: Return one row with one column, avg_bonus: the average bonus_pct across all employees, rounded to 2 decimal places. An employee with no bonus_pct counts as 0.
hints: What does avg do with a NULL value?
Give the missing percentages a value before avg sees them.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Averages only the employees who have a bonus.
Removes the employees with no bonus before averaging.

feedback: Decide what the total is divided by. Here it must be all 24 employees.
